notes: taketh in hunting divides as verb plus the bare cognate accusative with its supplied in (rule 33); the English verb's own object is any beast, so rule 44's supplied-preposition clause does not reach it.
The any of any beast joins the noun under rule 15, since no kol stands on it.
The waw of we-shafakh goes unrepresented, the ASV writing no connective at the apodosis.
The assimilated article of be-'afar is unrepresented: the ASV writes with dust without a the.
